purpose: Choose the exact one-step meaning of controlled definition opening after identity/scope/addressability have been challenged, without conflating opening with equality, interpretation, proof or recursive normalization.

models.name: lookup-and-return-typed-body
models.operation: open_definition(target, environment) -> match(definitionId, body, provenance) | no-match | conflict | non-addressable
models.reason: A one-step opening exposes exactly the typed RHS introduced by ':' and stops. It neither evaluates that body nor rewrites arbitrary caller syntax, so contextual interpretation and proof remain explicit later operations.

models.name: lookup-and-immediately-interpret-body-in-caller-context
models.reason: Conflates definition lookup with L2 interpretation, cannot uniformly handle RHS Form versus constraint Expression, and makes a ContextFrame hidden input to what should be a stable definition lookup. A caller may explicitly interpret a returned body later where that operation is defined.

models.name: definition-becomes-equality
models.reason: A : F does not assert unrestricted A = F and must not authorize substitution by equality.

models.name: global-ast-replacement
models.reason: Opening one definition must not replace every structurally similar occurrence or erase occurrence/scope identity.

models.name: recursive-normalize-until-no-definitions
models.reason: Self-closed root definitions are intentionally recursive; a single opening step must terminate without searching for a global normal form.

preferredOperation.name: open_definition
preferredOperation.typedBody: the registered Definition.value Expression unchanged by interpretation or normalization

contextBoundary.importantExample: opening ∞ returns the typed body {◁ = ∞, ▷ = ∞}; ◁ and ▷ remain unresolved until a separate explicit contextual operation

addressabilityBoundary.currentCandidateAddressableSubset: closed targets with no occurrence-local anonymous [] and no ContextPronoun
addressabilityBoundary.anonymousSquareTarget: non-addressable in this candidate rather than globalized by structural shape
addressabilityBoundary.contextPronounTarget: non-addressable in this candidate rather than promoted to a global definition name

recursionBoundary.selfDefinition: a : a opens once to body a and stops
recursionBoundary.mutualDefinition: a : b opens once to body b and stops; a later explicit opening of b is a separate step
recursionBoundary.reason: Cycle handling belongs to an explicit multi-step traversal/proof/search layer, not to a one-step lookup-and-return operation.

negativeConsequences: successful opening does not prove target = body
successful opening does not rewrite all target occurrences
successful opening does not recursively open body symbols
successful opening does not bind or evaluate ContextPronoun
successful opening does not read or realize associative memory
successful opening does not become a trusted mts-proof rule

requiredVectors: all ten root definitions one-step open to their exact typed RHS
infinity body keeps ContextPronoun nodes unresolved
Form RHS and constraint-bundle RHS are both returned without evaluation
self and mutual definitions terminate after exactly one opening
same target in child scope opens nearest definition and carries distinct DefinitionId
anonymous [] target is not silently globalized
ContextPronoun target is not silently globalized
opening API has no ContextFrame or MemoryView input

releaseGate: pass the executable one-step opening challenge
publish language-neutral positive and negative opening conformance
make an explicit Accepted semantic contract decision
only then integrate the accepted operation into the single production path
only after production semantics are accepted evaluate a candidate L5 definition-opening proof rule
